inputs.support_context: Separate source-owned catalogue and secondary memberships plus permitted event metadata. Stable pseudonyms preserve joins; they are not anonymization or authority.
inputs.fit_validation: Whole-mouse original roles; responses released only in FIT/validation; two policies remain named.
inputs.query: Context cases for both policies, no neural response/baseline/trace/target; exact canonical encoded query digests and compound investigation binding.

original_support.no_success: Text-only nonidentifiability, unknown counts treated as zero, absent selected conditions treated as catalogue absence, or incomplete protected source support.

predictions.coverage: Each supported query case exactly once, including control and unknown subsets. No candidate row or context deletion.

capture: All four products captured and reauthenticated before target opening. The actual investigation context owns all subsequent parsing, consumers, report building and direct publication. Any failure is terminal, retains its raw first exception and independent cleanup/effect evidence, and forbids later successful report publication.
evidence: Separate quantitative support correctness and source-aligned observational neural errors/contrasts; both fixed references; all availability dispositions; no causal or significance claim.
resource_boundary: Actual ordinary-file transport is bounded and controlled. Native source admission, full-panel physical budgets, isolated roles and private authority remain missing producers.
